updates.update_type: existing maritime drawer update / new commercial denominator
updates.finding: Reuters/Kpler reported 12 trackable commodity-vessel transits through Hormuz over the weekend, down from 35 the prior weekend. Sunday comprised four exits and two entries; Saturday five exits and one entry. Reuters notes AIS-visible traffic understates dark transits. Prewar baseline cited was about 125 large commercial vessels daily.
updates.status: SUPPORTED COMMERCIAL-DATA DENOMINATOR; NOT NORMALIZED FREEDOM OF NAVIGATION
updates.drawer_effect: Supersede the noon sweep's unresolved request for the next reliable Kpler denominator. Preserve prior daily counts as their own observation times.

updates.finding: Kpler provisional data reported Saudi crude exports recovered above 4 million bpd so far in September after 2.4 million bpd in August. Thirteen tankers carrying about 34 million barrels exited Hormuz in the week of Sep. 13; Saudi Arabia accounted for about half of exports and Iraq 35%. Reuters attributes the Saudi routing shift to attacks on the East-West pipeline and reduced Yanbu shipments.
updates.status: SUPPORTED COMMERCIAL-DATA FLOW UPDATE; PIPELINE REPAIR STATUS NOT RESOLVED
updates.drawer_effect: Update Saudi Petroline/Yanbu disposition with observed export rerouting and recovery; do not infer repaired pipeline or restored Yanbu capacity.

updates.finding: Reuters reported President Trump said he was open to meeting Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian during UN General Assembly week while also issuing renewed threats if Iran did not make a deal. Iran simultaneously reiterated conditions-first Hormuz/negotiation sequencing. This is an expressed willingness to meet, not evidence of a scheduled meeting or agreed negotiating framework.
updates.status: SUPPORTED PUBLIC POSITION; NO MEETING OR AGREEMENT CONFIRMED
updates.drawer_effect: Add U.S. meeting openness alongside Iranian conditions-first posture; preserve both without inferring convergence.

updates.finding: Reuters preserved Iran's military claim that it possessed information an attack was being prepared, but reported no elaboration. No independent evidence located in this sweep substantiates privileged Iranian foreknowledge. A subsequent attack, if one occurs, must not by itself validate the claimed intelligence provenance.
updates.drawer_effect: No adjudicative upgrade. Preserve warning, retaliation policy, and claimed intelligence provenance as separate propositions.
